subject.title: feat(ui): approval UX overhaul — inline cards, fair queue, shortcuts, badges

question: Should the maintainer-sponsored approval UX overhaul land after the two safety defects and real-flow proof are resolved, or should its scope be narrowed to a smaller approved interaction model?
rationale: This is a large new approval interaction surface carrying a protected maintainer label; code review can identify defects, but maintainers must confirm the permanent operator UX and acceptable shortcut semantics.

options.title: Sponsor and complete the overhaul
options.body: Resolve the concrete session/shortcut defects and require redacted real approval-flow proof before merging the broader queue, inline-card, and badge design.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land only the least-risky visibility improvements after a focused redesign, leaving inline cards and shortcut behavior for a separately specified follow-up.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and complete the overhaul
recommendation.body: Resolve the concrete session/shortcut defects and require redacted real approval-flow proof before merging the broader queue, inline-card, and badge design.

likelyOwner.reason: The active branch history and assignment indicate they are the closest available routing candidate for the intended approval UX.
